title: Ana Karenina
description: Described by William Faulkner as the best novel ever written and by Fyodor Dostoevsky as “flawless,” Anna Karenina tells of the doomed love affair between the sensuous and rebellious Anna and the dashing officer, Count Vronsky. Tragedy unfolds as Anna rejects her passionless marriage and thereby exposes herself to the hypocrisies of society. Set against a vast and richly textured canvas of nineteenth-century Russia, the novel's seven major characters create a dynamic imbalance, playing out the contrasts of city and country life and all the variations on love and family happiness.

es.description: Ana Karenina es una de las cumbres de la literatura universal y la obra maestra de León Tolstói. Ambientada en la alta sociedad rusa del siglo XIX, la novela entrelaza historias de amor, matrimonio, fe, deber y deseo, explorando con profundidad psicológica las consecuencias de las decisiones humanas. A través del inolvidable retrato de Ana y de personajes complejos como Levin y Kitty, Tolstói examina la moral, la hipocresía social y la búsqueda de sentido. Monumental, emotiva y filosófica, esta novela sigue siendo una lectura imprescindible para comprender la condición humana.
